_about: REAL committed covenant rows (W64), each with verbatim slices of the EDGAR exhibits it cites, cut from the operator's SEC cache on 2026-11-19 through html_to_text at 5e380efc (cache only; EDGAR filings are public). Each slice is text[start:end] of its document; a document's slices are joined in order by ' [gap] '. expect is the check's answer on the slices AND on the whole document, asserted when cut. A row read from a frozen page names it in `page` and is read there; rows from git history are stored verbatim in `rows`, the case's own first.
